title: The Resonant Companion
summary: A companion for the resonant soul that adds a ring of sympathy round an ally and a long mending of overtone.

title: A Treatise on the Swelling Field
summary: A treatise on spreading a field of tone over a whole company and swelling it until the stunned soul is rung awake.

title: Treatise of the Paired Voices
summary: A treatise on two souls sounding as a pair on twin tracks so that each fills the quiet places of the other.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Clear Note
summary: A manual of the high bright note that carries far like a hawk's cry and lifts the soul of every ally who hears it.

title: The Oath-Sung Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of songs sworn on the wind by which allies hold to their work and are called back from the edge.

title: Treatise on the Bearing Note
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing by the tone each soul returns and holding allied souls to a true course.
